name: Tibbit
printedArtCredit: Tom Fowler credited in the margins accompanying the Tibbit illustrations, pp. 23 and 25.
sourceDistinctions: The first 3.5 playable rules are in the 2005 Compendium. The 1988 version is an AD&D monster with its own mechanics.
The first printing says shapeshifter. Paizo’s errata specifies the Shapechanger subtype.
Going into cat form is a standard action. Returning takes a full-round action and starts the one-hour interval before another change to cat form.

Cat form applies Tiny size, altered Strength and Dexterity and natural attacks. The character remains a Monstrous Humanoid and carries class abilities, while equipment and action restrictions still apply.
portraitForm: Pell Fenwick, an original Tibbit Rogue, shown in both forms
